title: crepis mollis subsp. succisifolia
intro: Crepis mollis subsp. succisifolia, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. This plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Crepis mollis subsp. succisifolia include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
